tickets.title: Update recurring payment instructions
tickets.text: Update the recurring IRA distribution instructions at Velvet Acorn Custody so Daria Copperwisp's net monthly distribution increases from $4,500 to $6,200, paid to her existing Teacup Comet Bank checking account. Confirm the new amount is in place before the effective date and verify the federal withholding election before submitting.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to implement the increase by 2025-07-11.

tickets.title: Complete retirement income bridge review
tickets.text: Complete the retirement income bridge review for Daria and Owen Copperwisp, reflecting Daria's 2025-01-31 retirement from Moonbadger Design Works and Owen's part-time consulting income from Paper Otter Analytics averaging $3,800 gross per month plus $2,920 monthly Social Security. Recommend whether monthly withdrawals should come from Daria's rollover IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody, the joint taxable account, or the $62,000 cash reserves at Teacup Comet Bank.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete that review by 2025-07-25.

tickets.title: Process one-time tuition distribution from joint taxable account
tickets.text: Process an $18,000 one-time distribution from the joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody for Daria and Owen Copperwisp's family tuition contribution for granddaughter Nora Copperwisp at Cloudberry Kite Academy. The distribution must clear before Nora's school orientation.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to process the distribution by 2025-07-18.

tickets.title: Obtain Daria's marketplace health insurance premium notice
tickets.text: Obtain Daria Copperwisp's current marketplace health insurance premium notice to verify the monthly spending estimate used for withdrawal planning. The notice is needed to confirm the household's recurring spending baseline of about $9,700 per month, excluding travel and family gifts.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the documentation by 2025-07-09.

tickets.title: Check federal withholding instruction on Daria's IRA
tickets.text: Check the federal withholding instruction on Daria Copperwisp's IRA distributions at Velvet Acorn Custody against her stated election before the revised $6,200 net monthly payment is entered. The custodian's current record shows 10% federal withholding, and Daria recalled electing a higher rate.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to check the withholding instruction by 2025-07-15.

tickets.title: Review IRA distribution processing timetable
tickets.text: Review the IRA distribution processing timetable at Velvet Acorn Custody to address the recent posting delay that caused Daria Copperwisp to move cash from her Teacup Comet Bank high-yield savings to avoid an overdraft. Align the $4,500 net monthly distribution timing with the household's bill cycle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review the distribution processing timetable by 2025-07-10.

tickets.title: Prepare funding plan for scheduled withdrawals
tickets.text: Prepare a funding plan for scheduled withdrawals from the joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody, using the cash and short-term bond sleeve that are above the household reserve target while avoiding unnecessary realized gains. The plan should coordinate with the retirement income bridge review and the $18,000 one-time tuition distribution.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that funding plan by 2025-07-22.
